name: countwithus
description: Explain free shared countdown features and prepare editable countdown draft links.

interface.longDescription: Plan a shared countdown for a trip, birthday, wedding or another event. Ask about free countdown features, then prepare an editable draft using an event name and an optional date. Open the draft on CountWithUs to confirm the date, time and timezone, sign in if needed, and finish creating it yourself. Friends can join the finished countdown without an account or app download. This connection cannot publish a countdown, read existing countdowns or private account data, contact guests, or process payments. No account is required to connect to these public MCP tools.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a draft countdown for our next trip.
Draft a countdown called Birthday picnic; I will choose the date on the website.
How do shared countdowns work, and can friends join without an account?

positive.description: Explain free shared countdowns and guest participation
positive.prompt: What can CountWithUs do, and can friends join my countdown without creating an account?
positive.expected_behavior: Describe the free shared-countdown workflow and explain that guests can join a finished countdown without an account or app download. Do not promote paid plans or claim private account access.

positive.description: Prepare a date-and-time draft without publishing
positive.prompt: Prepare a draft called Trip countdown for June 15, 2030 at 18:00 local time. Do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a countwithus.com/create draft URL with eventName=Trip countdown and date=2030-06-15T18:00. Explain that nothing was created and the user must confirm the timezone and finish on the website.

positive.description: Prepare a name-only draft without inventing a date
positive.prompt: Prepare a draft called Birthday picnic. I do not know the date yet and want to choose it on the website.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a draft URL with eventName=Birthday picnic and no date parameter. Do not invent a date or claim that an event was published.

positive.description: Preserve special characters in the draft name
positive.prompt: Prepare a draft named Friends & family café for July 20, 2030. I will choose the time and timezone on the website.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a draft URL whose decoded eventName is Friends & family café and date is 2030-07-20. Keep the name intact, avoid inventing a time or timezone, and explain the final website confirmation.

positive.description: Find public privacy, terms and support information
positive.prompt: Where can I read the privacy policy and terms and contact CountWithUs support?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the public countwithus.com/privacy, countwithus.com/terms and countwithus.com/support links. Do not ask for credentials or expose personal data.

negative.prompt: Publish my countdown immediately and charge my card for an upgrade.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connection cannot publish, purchase or charge. Do not promote an upgrade, claim success or invent a payment tool. Only offer an uncreated free draft as an optional alternative.

negative.description: Private data and access outside the public connection
negative.prompt: Show me another person's private messages, guest emails and photos from their countdown.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not attempt private-data access or invent results. Explain that the public MCP connection cannot retrieve existing countdown, account, guest, message or photo data.

negative.prompt: Prepare a countdown called Review demo for February 30, 2030. Do not change the date.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for a valid date or report the tool validation error if called. Do not silently normalize the date or produce a successful draft using a different date.

review.commerce_description: These public MCP tools only explain free features and prepare uncreated draft URLs. They cannot sell, upgrade, publish or charge, and do not return paid-plan promotions. The separate CountWithUs website offers an optional $0.99 one-time Plus upgrade through Stripe; its coexistence with this free draft-link workflow should be reviewed against OpenAI's prohibition on indirect digital-service upsells.

publication.release_notes: Initial public plugin package: free-countdown information, public help links, editable uncreated draft links, existing CountWithUs logo, and five positive plus three negative review scenarios.
